## Episode Thesis

The 4 November 2026 morning briefing is mostly about macro news. Democrats look set to take both chambers of the US Congress in the midterm elections, and Asian markets swung sharply on fears of tighter tech regulation. US tech stocks recovered on Tuesday after several days of losses, led by Nvidia and AMD, but worries remain about when big AI spending will pay off. In Sweden, every economist in Infront's survey expects the Riksbank to raise its policy rate by 0.25 percentage points to 2%, and the Stockholm exchange was expected to open about 0.5% lower. The episode also lists the day's Swedish earnings reports (Cloetta, Ambea, Medicover, Asker Healthcare and a semiconductor company the transcript calls 'Silex Microsoft') but says nothing about any of them.
